integrity: Analytic block-incidence proof with six pair types and sharp negative witness; symbolic/exact-arithmetic reproduction program, 24 base graphs, 9338 coefficient comparisons; self-review only, independent audit not performed.
limitations: Finite simple connected unweighted d-regular base graphs, d>=2, one full subdivision per edge, combinatorial Laplacian, completed classical RK4 step; no claim about internal stages, irregular/weighted graphs or non-RK4 methods. Full coverage of all historical literature is uncertain.
title: Sharp classical RK4 positivity on every subdivided regular graph
